# ffttasd Godot VFX reference projects

This folder keeps local test copies of two public Godot reference projects:

- `wind_ribbon`: https://github.com/ffttasd/wind_ribbon, pulled at `8e3e6a5`
- `godot_fog_card`: https://github.com/ffttasd/godot_fog_card, pulled at `2c233c5`

They are used as prototype references for `YujianSpriteSequencePrototype`.
The current prototype adapts the wind ribbon and fog-card ideas into local 2D drawing code instead of wiring these 3D scenes directly into the formal runtime.
